description: Prepare a 15-minute review for a UTC point-in-time restore into a NEW database, using the current storage generation. Deploy scope. Does not queue recovery or switch traffic. Review the source, target, available WAL range and digest before applying. Optional target_binding_id selects an eligible binding. Hosted MCP requires an account credential without resource confinement.

deployment_id.description: The managed PostgreSQL provider deployment, not the consuming app.

name: impreza_prepare_pitr_restore
title: Review point-in-time restore
